citations.assessment: The event begins at the end of 11b and the actual ‘my son’ speech begins 12a. The Bavli’s Perida agrees broadly with Heilprin.

The checked Tosefta has Perida with first name supplied in brackets as Yosef. The compared Yerushalmi has Yose ben Perora and the student's title. The separately linked Heilprin entry gives Yose ben Yose ben Petora.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
